parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, which means I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. My job involves planning and running flights for deliveries and inspections, and I can call off a flight if needed. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and our company policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. However, I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts.
